args: set -euo pipefail; best=; best_m=0; while IFS= read -r -d '' s; do [[ -x "$s" ]] || continue; m=$(stat -f %m "$s" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$s"); if [[ "$m" -ge "$best_m" ]]; then best_m=$m; best=$s; fi; done < <(find "$HOME/.cursor/plugins" -name 'vgv-ask-question-mcp.sh' -type f -print0 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$best" ]] || { echo 'vgv-ask-question-mcp: launcher not found under ~/.cursor/plugins' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$best"
